scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && docker compose up -d && npm run db:migrate --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
